company_name: Shanghai Silicology Scientific & Trading Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides critical materials and coatings used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Silicology Scientific & Trading Co., Ltd specializes in providing semiconductor-grade materials and services, including chemical vapor deposition (CVD) coatings for silicon carbide, pyrolytic graphite, and tantalum carbide. They are a major supplier of thermal insulation materials and carbon composites for semiconductor applications, serving the photovoltaic and flat panel display industries as well.
capabilities: CVD coatings for SiC, PG, and TaC

regional_presence.China: Largest agent for Japan Carbon Co., Ltd., supplying materials tailored for semiconductor applications.
